natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, rev +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence indicates that reducing onboarding friction improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. This directly addresses the current bottleneck while avoiding the known retention trade-off from discounting. Verify the two onboarding records before committing to confirm the intervention details, segment coverage, and durability of the effect.
